description: This file defines a command class for exporting a Superset dashboard as an example bundle, including datasets, charts, and dashboard YAML configurations, with support for exporting dataset data as Parquet files.

classes.name: ExportExampleCommand
classes.description: A command class for exporting a Superset dashboard as an example bundle with datasets, charts, and dashboard YAML configurations, optionally including dataset data in Parquet format.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the dashboard ID and loads the dashboard object.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Generates and yields filename and content generator tuples for packaging the dashboard export, including datasets, charts, and dashboard YAML files, with optional dataset data.
